meta.purpose: Canvas and format specifications for poster-making — single source of truth. Never hardcode sizes elsewhere; scripts and templates read from here.

sources.cell: Cell Press author guidelines (1200x1200 @300dpi), via SSRN survey of 49 publishers
sources.poster_design: Purrington poster guide (colinpurrington.com); UCSD/OSU/UCT library guides; Bentsen & Ostergaard 2025 J Cancer Educ

conference_posters.note: Conferences usually prescribe a SIZE, not a template. Always check the call for papers; parameterize the canvas from these presets.

graphical_abstracts.note: Per-journal specs; check the target journal's guide for authors — several INFORMS journals and AGU have NO graphical abstract channel at all (plain-text abstract only), for those use social_cards instead.

elsevier.fonts: Times / Arial / Courier / Symbol; must stay readable at 200px height in the TOC window
elsevier.optional: per-journal opt-in; displayed on ScienceDirect only, separate file

wiley.ratio: same banner shape as Elsevier (official wording lists 531x1328 h x w)

ieee.optional: per-journal, some require peer review of the abstract itself

springer_nature.spec: no publisher-wide spec; follow per-journal Instructions for Authors; Nature-branded ~7:5 landscape

social_cards.note: Screen medium, pixel units. Element canon (Ibrahim visual abstract): claim-style headline + central method/result visual + authors/affiliation + journal citation & DOI. Export PNG (and vector PDF for reprinting).

qr_code.note: better-poster canon: QR links to the paper (DOI / arXiv / personal page). Generate with qrcode Python package, error correction M, >= 1.2cm printed side on posters, quiet zone 4 modules.
